stem: A client with a productive cough asks what guaifenesin is intended to do. Which response is correct?

options.A: It is an expectorant that helps loosen phlegm and thin bronchial secretions to make coughs more productive.
options.B: It is an opioid that completely suppresses the respiratory drive.
options.C: It permanently stops all mucus production.
options.D: It is an antibiotic used to eradicate viral upper-respiratory infections.

rationale: OTC guaifenesin labeling identifies the drug as an expectorant and states that it helps loosen phlegm and thin bronchial secretions so coughs are more productive.
educational_objective: Explain the labeled therapeutic purpose of guaifenesin.
source_locator: Drug Facts—Purpose: Expectorant; Uses: loosens phlegm and thins bronchial secretions
source_claim_supported: Guaifenesin is an expectorant that loosens mucus and thins bronchial secretions.
correction_summary: Retained the core pharmacology but replaced padded distractors with clear alternative drug functions.
audit_findings: Correct action is the exact OTC use.
Independent second pass found one best answer.
